correctness.rationale: The explicit monotone circle-arc chart extends to a two-fixed-point homeomorphism, and the decaying oscillatory cocycle extends continuously. Uniform Birkhoff sums O(n^(1-beta)) give the singleton rotation set. The central O(n) strips times O(n^(1-beta)) fractional samples yield a sharp upper bound; far-left monotone terminal-phase binning yields a smaller O(n^(2-2beta)) bound. O(n) different passage-time strips, each with O(n^(1-beta)) angular starting values, are Bowen separated: the same-strip fiber displacement is monotonically increasing from zero with individual increments o(1), so its first passage through a fixed small positive scale is detected modulo one. The matching exponent is 2-beta, and the polynomial upper bound implies h_top=0. The standalone script executed VERIFY_OK on 9 parameter/horizon combinations; this supports only finite checks.

value.rationale: The constructed family realizes every polynomial entropy exponent strictly between one and two with singleton rotation set and zero topological entropy on T2, filling a natural open interval in Corrêa 2026 Problem 1. Its two independent sources of orbit complexity—linear passage-time choices and sublinear n^(1-beta) phase choices—have a sharp matching asymptotic exponent, distinguishing polynomial orbit growth from both ordinary entropy and rotation-set diversity. The construction is not merely a finite computation or renamed frozen-base formula, though it does not settle smoother, minimal, or other-exponent variants.
